question: A postmenopausal woman presents with a 10 cm complex adnexal mass. Transvaginal ultrasound shows solid areas, papillary projections, and moderate ascites. Which investigation is most useful for risk stratification to determine whether she requires referral to a gynaecological oncologist?

answers.text: Serum CA-125 combined with ultrasound morphology score and menopausal status (Risk of Malignancy Index, RMI)

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. The RMI combines CA-125, ultrasound morphology, and menopausal status to stratify the risk of malignancy. An RMI >200 warrants referral to a gynaecological oncologist. CA-125 alone has insufficient specificity in premenopausal women.

answers.text: Serum AFP and LDH alone to identify germ cell tumours

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. AFP and LDH are tumour markers for germ cell tumours, which predominantly affect young women (<30 years). A postmenopausal woman with a complex mass is more likely to have an epithelial ovarian tumour; the RMI (CA-125 + ultrasound + menopausal status) is the appropriate first-line risk stratification tool.

answers.text: CT-guided percutaneous biopsy of the adnexal mass

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Percutaneous biopsy of an ovarian mass is generally avoided because of the risk of cyst rupture and tumour spillage, which can upstage disease. Tissue diagnosis is obtained at staging laparotomy.

answers.text: Tumour inhibin B as the first-line marker in postmenopausal women

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Incorrect. Inhibin B is a marker for granulosa cell tumours (sex cord-stromal tumours), not for the more common epithelial ovarian cancers. The RMI using CA-125 is the recommended first-line risk stratification.

overallFeedback.feedback: The Risk of Malignancy Index (RMI) = CA-125 × ultrasound score × menopausal status. RMI >200 indicates high risk and warrants referral to a gynaecological oncologist.
Correct. RMI (CA-125 + ultrasound morphology + menopausal status) is the standard risk stratification tool for adnexal masses.
